d: We are looking for an experienced DevSecOps Engineer to integrate security practices into the software development and deployment lifecycle. The ideal candidate will be responsible for implementing and maintaining secure CI/CD pipelines, automating security processes, identifying vulnerabilities, and ensuring compliance with security standards across cloud infrastructure and applications.
The role requires strong expertise in DevOps, cloud technologies, automation, and application security.
q: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
3–7 years of experience in DevOps, DevSecOps, Cloud Security, or a related role.
Strong experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps.
Hands-on experience with security testing tools and technologies:
Strong knowledge of scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and container security.
Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation.
Good understanding of cloud security across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Knowledge of application security principles, OWASP Top 10, and secure coding practices.
Understanding of networking, firewalls, IAM, encryption, and authentication protocols.
Familiarity with security frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST, and CIS Benchmarks.
r: Integrate security practices into CI/CD pipelines and automate security testing throughout the software development lifecycle.
Design, implement, and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps.
Implement automated security scanning, including SAST, DAST, SCA, and container security testing.
Identify, assess, and remediate security vulnerabilities in applications, infrastructure, and deployment environments.
Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) security practices and scanning.
Secure cloud environments across AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
Manage secrets, credentials, encryption, and access control mechanisms.
Implement container and Kubernetes security best practices.
Collaborate with Development, Security, and Operations teams to embed security throughout the development lifecycle.
Monitor security events, investigate incidents, and support vulnerability management activities.
Establish security policies, standards, and best practices for DevOps processes.
Ensure compliance with relevant security frameworks and standards.
Continuously improve security automation, monitoring, and incident response processes.

d: The Driver / Messenger is responsible for providing safe and efficient transportation services for company personnel, documents, materials, and goods. The role includes delivering and collecting official documents from government authorities, customers, suppliers, banks, and other organizations while ensuring compliance with company procedures and traffic regulations.
q: High School certificate or equivalent preferred.
Minimum 2 years of driving experience in Bahrain.
Good knowledge of Bahrain roads, business districts, and government offices.
Experience dealing with government authorities and document processing is an advantage.
Basic English communication skills; Arabic knowledge is an added advantage.
Ability to maintain professionalism when interacting with customers, suppliers, and government officials.
Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
Clean driving record and strong safety awareness.
r: Safely operate company vehicles for the transportation of personnel, documents, and materials.
Deliver and collect official documents, parcels, and correspondence from customers, suppliers, banks, government offices, and other stakeholders.
Handle transactions and submissions with government authorities, including LMRA, GOSI, municipalities, customs authorities, ministries, and other regulatory bodies as required.
Ensure timely collection and delivery of documents, invoices, purchase orders, permits, and other company-related materials.
Maintain accurate records of deliveries, collections, and trips performed.
Conduct daily vehicle inspections and ensure the assigned vehicle is maintained in a clean and roadworthy condition.
Monitor vehicle service schedules and notify the supervisor of maintenance requirements.
Assist administrative departments with external errands and operational support activities.
Ensure the confidentiality and security of company documents and information.
Report accidents, vehicle defects, traffic violations, or operational issues to the supervisor immediately.
Support office and operational departments with additional duties as assigned.

d: To provide logistics, stores and inventory support that maximises the availability and operational readiness of simulator and synthetic training equipment.

The role is responsible for controlling and tracking simulator spares, repairable assets, consumables and associated equipment throughout their lifecycle. Working closely with Maintenance, Engineering, Procurement, Finance and external suppliers, the post holder will ensure inventory accuracy, asset accountability, cost-effective stockholding and regulatory compliance while supporting equipment availability.
q: Experience within stores, logistics, inventory, supply chain or material-support operations.
Experience using computerised inventory and/or asset-management systems.
Good understanding of inventory-control processes, including stock reconciliation, traceability and discrepancy investigation.
Ability to analyse material-related issues and identify practical solutions.
Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage competing operational requirements.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical teams, management, suppliers and other stakeholders.
Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a cross-functional team environment.
Good problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Competence in Microsoft Office and relevant business systems.
Commercial awareness, with an understanding of the relationship between inventory management, equipment availability and cost.
r: Maintain accurate inventory, asset and material records within TCMS, ensuring effective control, traceability and reconciliation throughout the inventory lifecycle.
Monitor stock levels and material risks, identifying shortages, obsolescence concerns and other issues that could affect simulator availability.
Investigate inventory discrepancies and support corrective actions to maintain accurate stock records.
Maintain accurate and auditable records of simulator assets, components and configuration changes.
Ensure appropriate asset accountability and full traceability throughout the asset lifecycle.
Manage repairable assets throughout the repair cycle, maintaining accurate tracking and clear status visibility.
Liaise with Engineering, Procurement, suppliers and repair organisations to identify and progress appropriate repair solutions.
Monitor repair turnaround times, supplier performance and material risks, escalating issues that could affect operational availability.
Support the evaluation of alternative suppliers and repair routes to improve availability, supply resilience and value for money.
Support procurement and lifecycle-management activities by providing accurate inventory information and recommendations.
Help optimise stockholding, control costs and mitigate material obsolescence risks.
Provide inventory and usage information to support purchasing and material-planning decisions.
Process goods receipt, storage, issue, return and despatch activities in accordance with company procedures.
Prepare equipment and materials for shipment and coordinate transportation using approved carriers and service providers.
Support import and export activities, ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory, security and company requirements.
Support Maintenance and Engineering teams by ensuring timely material availability.
Prioritise logistics activities according to operational requirements.
Provide accurate inventory and material information to minimise equipment downtime and support training delivery.
Support audits, reporting and performance monitoring relating to inventory, repairable assets and supply-chain activities.
Drive improvements in TCMS utilisation, inventory accuracy, material control and logistics processes.
Investigate recurring material-support issues and contribute to corrective and preventive actions.
Develop and maintain performance information relating to inventory accuracy, stock availability, repair turnaround times and supplier performance.
x: Some local travel is required to support equipment movements, supplier engagement, repair activities and inventory-management requirements.
Occasional flexibility is required to respond to urgent operational requirements and changing business priorities.
The role involves responsibility for the control, handling and movement of high-value and operationally critical equipment.
Strict compliance with applicable security, safety, export-control and information-management requirements is essential.
